title: A local-scheme section descends to an open neighbourhood
statement: Let X be a scheme in universe u+1 [def-pc-scheme], i : X.Opens -> X.Etale [def-sc-zariski-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-site] with i followed by forget to Over X equal to X.restrictFunctor, and x a point. Let H be a functor from abelian etale sheaves on X to abelian etale sheaves on Spec(O_X,x), with coefficients AddCommGrpCat.{u+1} [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and adj an adjunction of H to direct image along X.fromSpecStalk x. Let F be an abelian etale sheaf on X. Write D_F and c_F for the explicitly constructed neighbourhood diagram and cocone [new-local-stalk-sections-comparison-map]. For every section s of H(F) on the terminal etale object of Spec(O_X,x), there exist an opposite open neighbourhood U and t in D_F(U) such that c_F(U)(t)=s.

source.place: Lemma 59.51.5, degree zero, proof steps (1)-(3), restricted to principal opens in an affine neighbourhood of x.

proof.text: Use the affine-open basis and the fully faithful cofilteredness criterion to form the cofiltered category of affine neighbourhoods of x. Restrict the supplied i to this category. The equality-induced openIso identifies its objects with affine open subschemes, and cancellation of their open inclusions proves compatibility of these identifications.

Construct the cone with the explicit LocalStalkSections.lift projections. Transport the unique-factorization property of fromSpecStalk_limit_affine_neighbourhoods through openIso to prove IsLimit of this cone. Every cone is sent to a compatible family of maps into canonical affine opens; its unique map to the stalk spectrum is transported back by cancellation of the openIso maps.

Whisker the existing local-stalk cocone by the affine-neighbourhood inclusion. Apply affineOpenSections_cocone_isColimit: lift_fac verifies that the limit projections lie over X.fromSpecStalk x, and the cocone-leg equation is definitional.

Concrete.isColimit_exists_rep supplies a representative in the opposite affine-neighbourhood category. Its image under the inclusion is the required open neighbourhood, with exactly the original cocone-leg equality.

proof_origin.place: Degree-zero continuity via an explicit affine neighbourhood limit and categorical representative extraction

mathlib_searches.query: Every section of an inverse image etale sheaf on Spec of a local ring descends to a section over an open neighborhood
mathlib_searches.results: 8 hits, including basicOpen_subset_etaleLocus_iff, RingHom.Etale.propertyIsLocal and Algebra.isOpen_etaleLocus. These concern ring maps, not descent of sections of an arbitrary abelian etale sheaf.
12 hits: uniqueness of left adjoints, its unit and counit compatibility; these are formal ingredients, not local-scheme section descent.

Mathlib Stalk.lean has fromSpecStalkOfMem and its factorization; concrete-category colimit lemmas supply representatives and equality from common restrictions. Upstream SectionContinuity and Sheaf EtaleSetSectionContinuity assume coefficients in universe one above the scheme universe and require a specified affine limit presentation. They do not directly supply the same-universe abelian neighbourhood cocone assertions here.
